prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Pet Quick Tutorial: Add an interactive tutorial screen after home welcome that explicitly demonstrates how to move, hide, summon, and interact with the desktop pet. (why: Support receives multiple inquiries (3 emails) regarding confusion about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet post-onboarding.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Adoption Customizer Grid: Redesign the friend selection screen into a split layout showcasing real-time pet preview cards with clear trait highlights. (why: Adoption stage has low conversion (60.9%) and support received 3 tickets about custom pets failing or looking wrong.)
2: [home, new_flow] Desktop Readiness & Display Verification Screen: Introduce a desktop display verification step during waiting to test rendering and ensure the pet displays properly on screen. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets failing to show up on desktop, and waiting step has a long mean duration of 2336s.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Adoption Completion: Move the sign_in step to occur right after waiting and right before home_intro so users sign in after creating their pet. (why: Overall onboarding completion is only 18.4% and users experience sign-in confusion before seeing their pet.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Account Syncing & Pet Preservation Info: Add copy and visual badges to path selection explaining how pet progress is saved to your account. (why: 8 support emails were received regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
5: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Clarity & Quality Hints: Add clear image specification hints and photo selection guidance components on the photo upload screen. (why: 3 support tickets cited failures or distorted outputs when making custom pets via photos.)

Reordering sign-in reduces early friction, improving overall completion rate.
Simple copy fix directly backed by 8 support emails regarding reset pets.
Low-cost guidance components help fix custom pet photo upload failures in adoption.
